scientific_integrity: One theorem is stated consistently in the result, slogan, review, and audit; source programs are supplied in full, with no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the single labeled 28-vertex Coxeter graph. The enumerations establish finite exhaustive counts, not a broader family theorem. Graph identification is independently checked against the Fano model. Publication priority remains subject to independently examining unindexed literature.
title: Strong odd colorings of the Coxeter graph: a fourteen-partition rigidity theorem
